CustomField.description: Portion of the total balance that is neither base rent, NNN/CAM nor late fees - typically prior-owner balances and miscellaneous billings. FSD 5.9.1 records that roughly a third of delinquency notes are DPEG billing corrections, and this bucket is where those usually sit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Everything not base rent, NNN/CAM or late fees - often prior-owner or billing-correction balances. Yardi-sourced and overwritten on every nightly sync. Never edit this value in Salesforce - it will be replaced.
CustomField.label: Other Outstanding Amount
